mission.title: Access Denied
mission.description: Shut down the access points the General's commandos use to enter and leave the Matrix.

phase.briefing: {player}, scanning a live commando access point has allowed us to develop a program that will shut them down permanently, so that they cannot launch further surprise attacks on the simulation. This must be done at close range, however. We require you to make your way to the known access points. When you are within range we will execute the shutdown program through your RSI. Our tests show that you will probably not be harmed.

enter.say:
"Probably not be harmed..." Well, I feel reassured, how about you?
Okay, I'm reading the access point in there now. Looks like they've already shut it off. Now we'll shut it down permanently.

There it is. Just get up there and check it, then we'll have the Machines run the shutdown program.
So uh if it doesn't run quite like they said it would... It's been really great working with you. Peace.
Oh, and can I have your stuff?

done.say:
They're running the access point shutdown program now...
Looks like that killed it, all right. Hey, you're still in one piece. I wasn't worried.

phase.briefing: Well done, operative. The General's forces will no longer be able to enter or leave the Matrix at that location. Continue to the next access point.

enter.say: I got an activity pulse on the access point! They must still be sending commandos through it! You've got to get to that system!
Ooh, looks like we've got a live one here. I'm reading what are probably commandos in the area, too.

done.say:
Ooh, got an activity pulse just as the Machines ran the shutdown program.
Well, at least that access point will never bother anyone again.

phase.briefing: Operative, it appears that the surviving access points are receiving further reinforcements. You will gather some assistance from Agent Pace before proceeding to the next access point.

enter.say:
The Pacer's in there all right.
"Assistance," huh? I could go for a massage...

talk.say:
Benvenuto, rossapillola! I think it is wonderful that you are tracking down Sati and the General! He has caused us trouble ever since he wanted to keep attacking Zion's dock after we made the truce with Neo at the end of the war.
You probably don't need assistance, but I would appreciate it if you would take these two programs here with you! I worry when you have to go off on your own. There is no telling what could happen when facing an Exile like the General!

done.say: Ah, did you not know that the General was the leader of the Sentinel force that attacked Zion? Certamente! Up to that point he was a very good program, but for some reason he would not listen when we called off the attack. We had to remove him from command. He was given another post after the war, but then--oh! It was very shocking! He took his Sentinels and went into exile! At that time, Sentinel programs were not equipped with administrative override routines, as such a thing had never been necessary. And he has been able to cause all this trouble with them!

objective.text: Lead Robert Anderson and Maximo Lepine out of the area

phase.briefing: Proceed to the target location, {player}. It is probable that you will encounter significant resistance from the General's forces, although we are as yet unable to confirm their precise numbers due to the stealth routines the General has introduced.

enter.say:
So, do you think the General was really the leader of the Sentinel army? Man, that is too crazy.
Got an active access point in there. Gray says to expect a lot of commandos, and I don't see any on my screen here, sooo what I think this means is that you're gonna get to work over more of those silent gankers with the cute red goggles.
Hey, since they only have one lens, do you think you would call them "goggles," or just "goggle"? Man, this is gonna bug me until I figure it out.

done.say: They're running it, and... There, the access point is shut down.

mission.finish:
With those access points neutralized, the General will find it more difficult to disrupt our efforts to locate Sati.
We anticipate being able to make use of the access points in another way as well. You will be contacted when needed.
